subtitle: Kitsune Trickster

lore: The fox spirit of Izumo has recently left her realm, where she was associated with rice, warriors, and blacksmiths, to observe the workings of Vyraj’s pantheon. Her intent was to determine if Vyraj were more likely an enemy or an ally, but instead she has engaged in a torrid love affair with the canine god Simargal.
